verdicts.note: The taxes axis asks whether to raise more revenue from high earners and wealth to fund services (pole_b) or hold the line and cut taxes (pole_a). Port's position concerns how an unchanged levy is spread across parcels, not how much revenue is raised. She says 'I am not advocating for higher taxes; I am demanding accurate taxes' and that the total the county collects 'doesn't have to change at all' [S5][S6], and she notes that the assessor does not set rates or budgets [S7]. She also promises to 'actively promote property tax exemptions and deferrals' [S1][S7], which leans the other way. Moving luxury and corporate parcels toward market value under a fixed levy is not 'expand progressive revenue ... to fund public investment', and none of the cited sources (S1, S5, S6) states a position on revenue or on funding services. Omit the axis.
